ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels constituting approximately 75% of the surface area, with high-intensity (white) pixels distributed in clusters and mottling across the remaining 25%.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dispersed high-intensity white circular rosettes and irregular linear patches distributed across a dark field. Concentrations of white pixels are highest at the distal tips and along the trailing edges of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped central depression dividing the lobes with a defined pixel-depth reaching approximately 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular and jagged boundary; features multiple high-amplitude peaks and valleys. Notable deep semi-circular excisions on the left lobe's trailing edge and jagged, irregular serrations on the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave curvature sweeping upwards and outwards from the median notch toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of roughly circular high-contrast white pixel groups (barnacle attachment scars) visible globally, with significant density at the distal tip of the left lobe and lower-mid section of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, thin white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) oriented diagonally, primarily visible on the mid-section and trailing edge of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Major traumatic indentations/tissue loss on the trailing edges of both lobes, creating a non-linear, jagged profile distinct from natural serration.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive 'donut-shaped' white circular markings with dark centers located on the lower-left ventral surface and upper-right distal tip.
